name: @avatark/participation-contracts
description: Renderer-neutral contracts for Sprint 19's visitor-participation domain: ParticipationRecord (a visitor's durable, additive claim to an already-legitimate, world-resolved encounter -- never a second consequence-derivation authority), ParticipationAuthorization (a pure re-resolved-live-availability decision, never trusting a stale snapshot), and ParticipationDenialReason. No implementations, no write method on anything simulation-authoritative -- ParticipationRecord is the ONLY new durable write this domain introduces.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
